## We’re building category-leading security products that solve real problems today and move us toward a future of self-securing software.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf36402426e171e063_team.svg)

### Leadership

Led by experienced founders who have built and scaled successful software companies before.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf364024753e71e061_early.svg)

### Ownership & impact

Real ownership, real impact. Small teams, fast decisions, and ideas that ship.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf364024739571e05e_seeds.svg)

### Momentum

Winning against legacy tools, earning trust from Deel, SoundCloud and Niantic.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf364024178f71e057_remote%20team.svg)

### How we work

With a home base in Belgium and regular company offsites to bring everyone together.

This is what we stand for

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf3640245bea71df4d_chevron-d.svg)

1

Humble & Curious

We are respectful knowledge seekers, aiming to learn from anyone & anything we encounter in our work. We, as employees and as a company, operate with honesty and fairness whether with each other or the world. Aikido doesn’t value money over people.

2

Transparent & Open

We are open and honest with each other, never using that phrase as an excuse to be disrespectful. Our practices invite transparency by default, always finding new ways to share information with each other and the world. No gatekeepers here.

3

Disagree, then commit

We love to disagree at Aikido. Focusing on open discussions means we can learn from disagreements and grow together. All opinions are heard before we make a decision, but once it's made we all dedicate ourselves to it as if it was always our first choice.

4

Ownership

We encourage everyone to take the reins. Not waiting till everything is 100% clear, but starting and adapting along the way. To us, progress is more important than process.

5

Keep it simple, silly

We’ve all experienced the negative effects of complexity; it slows down progress, confuses people, and even enables hacking. Keeping things simple is hard, but we believe it’s worth the effort. Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

Benefits

Challenging, but rewarding.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf3640244db771e048_competitive.svg)

Competitive salary.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/642adcaf364024552e71df01/642adcaf3640248a9f71e044_flexible.svg)

Flexible working hours.
